Class ClientEyeRuntime

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.client.ClientEyeRuntime
public final class ClientEyeRuntime extends Object
Loader-neutral owner of every client eye simulation and its lifecycle: mobs, boats, placed heads, framed items, items in hands (first and third person), and GUI items. World presentations share one simulation clock that stops while the game is paused; GUI items have their own clock that keeps running. It also owns the one nested draw context that tells an item or head draw which GUI slot, animation, and head it belongs to.

    • tick

      public static void tick(@Nullable net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, boolean simulate, @Nullable Object activeView)
      One client tick: advance the GUI clock and simulate GUI items shown in activeView (or the HUD), and, when simulate is true, advance the world clock and simulate the world presentations rendered this tick or last. The client lifecycle disables world simulation while the game is paused. With no level every simulation is dropped; with eyes hidden, simulations and hand reactions are dropped while received expression time still advances.
